title: Build full-viewport roster and durable conversation
description: Implement the responsive three-pane /chat shell, unified bot/channel roster, search and creation controls, durable transcript loading, named-channel addressing, active-turn recovery, streaming, and terminal reconciliation.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented locally with Gherkin-first coverage: full-viewport shell, unified searchable roster and creation flows, persistent direct-channel reuse, named-channel teammate addressing, durable history, active-turn recovery, SSE resume, and terminal reconciliation. Web verification previously passed typecheck, 45 tests, and static build before the final sheet integration; final rerun remains part of delivery.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Final local gates: black and ruff pass; 106 targeted Python tests pass; canonical messaging feature set passes 30 scenarios and 222 steps; web production build, typecheck, and all 45 web tests pass. Responsive dark-mode visual inspection covered mobile roster, conversation, inspector, tablet layout, long transcript, and the three-pane composition. Development data migration is complete and the post-audit is clean.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Complete in PR #346, squash commit 3fb29a57457df450a2f27d120ca9f126c279e6f1. The production web build and CI gates passed, and the green development Web workflow deployed the full-viewport roster and durable conversation workspace.
